## Fix #1 — SEV-1: pronunciationPosition single-subscription stream

**File**: `lib/src/audio/audio_engine.dart` (~line 243).

Currently:
```dart
Stream<Duration> get pronunciationPosition => _pronunciation.positionStream;
```

`_pronunciation` is a `just_audio` `AudioPlayer`. Its `positionStream` is a single-subscription stream. Multiple listeners throw `Bad state: Stream has already been listened to`. Wrap with broadcast and cache once on the field — do NOT recompute per call (would create a new broadcast adapter each time).

Replace with a `late final` broadcast stream:
```dart
late final Stream<Duration> pronunciationPosition =
    _pronunciation.positionStream.asBroadcastStream();
```

If the surrounding class layout makes `late final` awkward, use a private `_pronunciationPositionBroadcast` field initialized in the constructor or first access. Keep the API getter shape the same.

## Fix #2 — SEV-1: Decouple syllable highlight from includesBreakdown

**File**: `lib/src/features/reader/runtime/providers/word_tts_provider.dart`, `_startPronunciationHighlightTracking` (~line 280).

Currently:
```dart
if (!plan.includesBreakdown) {
  state = WordTtsState(tappedWordIndex: globalIndex);
  return;
}

final parts = _buildHighlightParts(plan);
if (parts.isEmpty) {
  state = WordTtsState(tappedWordIndex: globalIndex);
  return;
}
```

The first guard is wrong. Highlight is visual — even when only a full-word audio clip plays, if the entry has `syllables` or `breakdownSegments`, we should still render the syllable highlight (advancing against whatever clip is playing).

**Remove the `!plan.includesBreakdown` early-return**. Always call `_buildHighlightParts(plan)`. Keep the `parts.isEmpty` guard.

## Fix #3 — SEV-1: Diagnostic logging on highlight pipeline

**File**: `lib/src/features/reader/runtime/providers/word_tts_provider.dart`.

Add `debugPrint` calls (import `package:flutter/foundation.dart` if not already imported) at these spots:

1. At the very top of `_startPronunciationHighlightTracking`, before any guards:
```dart
debugPrint(
  '[Highlight] start global=$globalIndex includesBreakdown=${plan.includesBreakdown} '
  'syllables=${plan.entry.syllables.length} segments=${plan.entry.breakdownSegments.length}',
);
```

2. Right after `final parts = _buildHighlightParts(plan);`:
```dart
debugPrint('[Highlight] built parts=${parts.length} labels=${parts.map((p) => p.text).toList()}');
```

3. Inside the position-stream listener, only when active index changes (use a local `previousIndex` or compare against current state before update):
```dart
debugPrint('[Highlight] pos=${positionMs}ms active=$activeIndex parts=${state.highlightParts.length}');
```
